title: GRKV: Global Regression for Training-Free KV Cache Compression in Long-Context LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.31105v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) with extended context lengths rely on the key-value (KV) cache to support attention over prior tokens. However, maintaining the KV cache incurs substantial memory overhead, motivating KV-cache compression methods that enforce a fixed budget through eviction and merging. Modern eviction methods increasingly adopt span-based retention because preserving contiguous spans is empirically effective and better preserves semantic coherence. Yet, when combined with post-eviction merging, span-based retention concentrates merges onto a small set of span-boundary carrier tokens, producing a highly imbalanced merge pattern that exacerbates over-merging and increases information loss. To address this imbalance, we propose GRKV (Global Regression for KV Cache), a training-free KV-cache merging method that directly minimizes the discrepancy between compressed-cache and full-cache attention outputs. translated_title: GRKV：面向长上下文大语言模型的无训练KV缓存压缩的全局回归方法
translated_abstract: 具有扩展上下文长度的大语言模型（LLM）依赖键值（KV）缓存来支持对先前标记的注意力计算。然而，维护KV缓存会带来巨大的内存开销，这促使了通过淘汰与合并来执行固定预算的KV缓存压缩方法。现代淘汰方法越来越多地采用基于区间的保留策略，因为保留连续区间在经验上是有效的，并且能更好地保持语义连贯性。然而，当与淘汰后合并结合使用时，基于区间的保留策略会将合并集中在少数区间边界载体标记上，产生高度不平衡的合并模式，从而加剧过度合并并增加信息损失。为解决这一不平衡问题，我们提出了GRKV（KV缓存的全局回归），这是一种无需训练的KV缓存合并方法，它直接最小化压缩缓存与完整缓存的注意力输出之间的差异。GRKV使用岭回归……
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的KV缓存压缩方法GRKV，通过全局回归直接最小化压缩缓存与完整缓存注意力输出之间的差异，解决了基于区间保留策略中合并模式高度不平衡所导致的过度合并与信息损失问题。
en_tdlr: GRKV is a training-free KV-cache compression method that uses global regression to directly minimize the discrepancy between compressed-cache and full-cache attention outputs, addressing the highly imbalanced merge pattern caused by combining span-based retention with post-eviction merging.
